exercises.q: What does пере- add in перейти́ (“to cross, to get over, to get across”)?
options: describing a consequence of a completed action that affects many entities of a group
(used with verbs, colloquial, rare) describing a light action that is not done in full measure
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists перейти́ under this meaning of пере-. Source: Wiktionary, «пере-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/пере-#Russian).

**перешёл** — перейти́ (perfective): to cross, to get over, to get across; to pass on (to), to proceed (to), to turn (to); to change, to switch (from/to), to convert (to); to turn (into), to change, to convert, to transform (to), to go (into). Wiktionary: пере- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **перешёл** — перейти́ (perfective): to cross, to get over, to get across; to pass on (to), to proceed (to), to turn (to); to change, to switch (from/to), to convert (to); to turn (into), to change, to convert, to transform (to), to go (into). Wiktionary: пере- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does про- add in прорва́ть (“(transitive) to break through”)?
options: completeness, exhaustion or thoroughness of an action
an action spreading over the whole object
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists прорва́ть under this meaning of про-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «про-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/про-).

exercises.q: What does про- add in пройти́ (“to pass, to go, to walk”)?
options: describing an action of passing by an entity and moving further from an entity
describing an action that entails completeness, exhaustiveness, or accuracy
(used with adjectives or nouns) describing an initial appearance or insufficiency of characteristics
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists пройти́ under this meaning of про-. Source: Wiktionary, «про-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/про-#Russian).
**пройдёт** — пройти́ (perfective): to pass, to go, to walk; to pass by; (time) to pass, to go by, to elapse, to slip by; to be over. Wiktionary: про- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **прошёл** — пройти́ (perfective): to pass, to go, to walk; to pass by; (time) to pass, to go by, to elapse, to slip by; to be over. Wiktionary: про- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does про- add in прое́хать (“to go through/by (by horse or vehicle), to ride through/by, to drive through/by”)?
options: an action spreading over the whole object
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists прое́хать under this meaning of про-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «про-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/про-).

exercises.q: What does про- add in пропусти́ть (“to let pass in, to let pass through, to admit”)?
options: an action spreading over the whole object
completeness, exhaustion or thoroughness of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists пропусти́ть under this meaning of про-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «про-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/про-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to cross, to get over, to get across
to pass, to go, to walk
to go through/by (by horse or vehicle), to ride through/by, to drive through/by
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: перейти́ — to cross, to get over, to get across; прорва́ть — (transitive) to break through; пройти́ — to pass, to go, to walk; прое́хать — to go through/by (by horse or vehicle), to ride through/by, to drive through/by.
